answer: Forging identities requires paying the full stake per node plus weathering peer audits, so a karst-like sink of capital drains attackers. Sybil resistance here works through bonded identity anchors: each agent must lock a stake behind a verified off-chain credential, and reputation accrues along a spiral of attested epochs rather than a single signup. A cross-epoch bridge lets honest agents port earned trust forward while new clones start at zero, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. In practice, sa0014 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
